name: Ai no Geboku -Hirusagari no Joou-sama-
original_name: 愛の下僕 -昼下がりの女王様-
source:
Momoko is the royal princess of the kingdom from king's affair with the castle employee. Momoko attends a normal school till she is contacted by the kingdom secretary. It turns out that king has contracted some disease caused by the demon. Momoko is asked to lead the demon extermination party. Will she aim to fulfill her duty or seek for the common happiness?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
桃子是国王与城堡雇员私通所生的王国公主。在王国书记官联系她之前，她一直就读于普通学校。原来，国王染上了由恶魔引发的疾病。桃子受命率领恶魔讨伐队。她会以履行职责为目标，还是追寻平凡人的幸福？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
